deployments_detail.use: In-house AI production system (real-time OLED data, anomaly detection): design AI (30 days->8 hrs), quality analysis (3 wks->2 days)

Proprietary 'AI Production System' for OLED manufacturing that ingests and analyzes real-time process/quality data, automatically diagnoses causes of production anomalies, sends alerts to relevant engineers, and recommends corrective actions - cutting process/quality improvement time from ~3 weeks to 2 days. [LG Display (proprietary, in-house developed)]
deployments_detail.value: Process improvement time cut from 3 weeks to 2 days; contributes to >200 billion won (~$137-144M) in annual cost savings via higher yields

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered design algorithm that automates the compensation-pattern design for irregularly shaped OLED panels (curved edges, slim bezels), previously done manually by skilled engineers. [LG Display (proprietary)]
deployments_detail.value: Design finalization time reduced from ~1 month to about 8 hours

deployments_detail.use: Optical design AI that optimizes OLED panel color consistency across wide viewing angles, replacing lengthy manual optical simulation cycles. [LG Display (proprietary)]
deployments_detail.value: Optical simulation time reduced from about 5 days to under 1 day

deployments_detail.use: AI-based digital-twin panel solution 'DPS' (Display Panel Simulator) built on NVIDIA's physics-AI platform PhysicsNeMo, training AI models directly on simulation results and real OLED process data to accelerate R&D and manufacturing development. LG Display is the only Korean company to apply PhysicsNeMo in actual manufacturing; showcased at NVIDIA GTC 2026. [NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo (implemented with Korean startup AIsemy)]
deployments_detail.value: NVIDIA software optimization accelerates foundation-model training/fine-tuning up to 2x

deployments_detail.use: AI Virtual Lab / Virtual Design & Evaluation (VDE): a simulation-and-AI virtual environment that reproduces display panels digitally to optimize designs and detect defects before physical prototyping, targeting elimination of repeated pilot production/testing cycles for next-gen displays (optics, materials, devices, substrates). [LG Display (proprietary)]
deployments_detail.value: Aims to cut experimental/development testing costs by more than 50% by 2030; pilot production savings of 'several billion won'

deployments_detail.use: Participation in the NVIDIA-LG Group 'AI Factory' strategic partnership providing accelerated GPU computing infrastructure to train, simulate, validate and deploy AI applications; LG Display's DPS/digital-twin manufacturing work is cited as aligning with NVIDIA's AI Factory strategy for display design and manufacturing. [NVIDIA (Vera CPUs / Rubin GPUs, Omniverse, Cosmos)]

In-house AI office assistant 'Hi-D' (Heidi) for all employees, providing internal/external knowledge search, real-time meeting interpretation (Korean, English, Chinese, Vietnamese), auto-generated meeting minutes, document drafting and summarization. Built on LG AI Research's EXAONE LLM. [LG AI Research EXAONE (4.0)]
deployments_detail.value: ~10% average daily productivity improvement; >10 billion won saved annually by eliminating external subscription costs

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous outdoor delivery robots deployed at the Paju production campus to deliver coffee/beverages and items to employees at office buildings, integrated with a mobile ordering app and supporting batch/multi-order delivery. [Neubility (Neubie robot), operated via Hyundai Vendis]
